categories.main_business_segments: Aidite (Qinhuangdao) Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the dental materials and dental digital equipment sectors. Its main products include zirconia ceramic blocks for dental restorations, glass ceramics, resin materials, dental digital devices such as intraoral scanners, milling machines, sintering furnaces, 3D printers, and dental implant systems. The company also offers dental orthodontics, prevention, and treatment products, serving dental laboratories, clinics, and hospitals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including CAD/CAM (computer-aided design and manufacturing), 3D printing (additive manufacturing with light curing), rapid sintering technology for zirconia materials, and surface treatment technologies like SLA (sandblasting and acid etching) for implants. It maintains a full digital workflow from scanning, design, milling, sintering to final dental restoration production, emphasizing fast sintering (30-60 minutes) and high precision. The company also develops proprietary dental materials with high biocompatibility, aesthetics, and mechanical properties.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Aidite serves dental laboratories, dental clinics, dental hospitals, and dental technicians domestically and internationally. Its products are used for dental restorations, implants, orthodontics, and preventive dental care. The company’s major markets include China, the United States, Europe, Japan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Australia, targeting both mature and emerging dental markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and production facilities in Qinhuangdao. It has subsidiaries and local operations in the United States, Germany, South Korea, Japan, and other countries. Its products are sold globally, with significant revenue from overseas markets accounting for over 60% of total sales, including North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Aidite operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the dental supply chain. It produces dental restorative materials and digital dental equipment, supplying dental laboratories and clinical service providers. The company also engages in upstream activities through investments in zirconia powder manufacturers to secure raw material supply and reduce dependency on imports.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment focusing on new dental materials (e.g., bio-mimetic resin ceramics, 3D printing resins), digital dental equipment (high-precision scanners, milling machines, 3D printers), and dental implant systems. It emphasizes digital transformation, integrating clinical and laboratory workflows, and expanding digital dental ecosystems. Collaborations with top dental universities and research institutes support innovation. Strategic acquisitions, such as the Korean implant company Warantec, enhance product portfolios and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: Aidite generates revenue primarily through product sales of dental materials and digital dental equipment. It employs a combined direct sales model domestically targeting dental labs and clinics, and a distributor-based model internationally. The company also offers integrated digital dental solutions and services, enhancing customer stickiness and enabling bundled sales of materials and equipment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Aidite is positioned as a leading domestic player in China’s dental materials and digital equipment market, with growing international presence. It competes with established global dental material and equipment manufacturers, leveraging its technological innovation, product quality, and localized service advantages. The company benefits from early market entry, strong R&D capabilities, and expanding global sales networks, aiming to accelerate import substitution and increase market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Aidite reported revenues of approximately RMB 888 million, a 13.81% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 150 million, up 2.4%. The company’s total assets grew 77.12% to RMB 2.29 billion, and net assets increased 85.65% to RMB 1.99 billion. Overseas revenue accounted for 61.85% of total sales, reflecting rapid global expansion. R&D expenses rose 18.21% to RMB 47.36 million, representing 5.33% of revenue, underscoring sustained innovation investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Aidite emphasizes high-quality, biocompatible, and aesthetically superior dental materials such as zirconia ceramics with rapid sintering capabilities, enabling faster patient treatment cycles. Its digital dental equipment integrates advanced CAD/CAM and 3D printing technologies, offering precision, efficiency, and customization. The company provides comprehensive digital dental solutions connecting clinical and laboratory workflows, enhancing user experience and operational efficiency. Its global localized service network and strong regulatory certifications (FDA, CE, ISO) further differentiate it in the competitive dental industry.
